titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 99: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 99. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number ϥⲑ (top right, odd page) with a bar above and below as the frame (no strokes). Running title > · ⲙⲡⲥⲁϩ · < with its ornaments, no stroke over ⲙ. The text column starts at x 508–511 on this page. Every dot run was counted from the dot x-positions. Dotted ϣ: l. 10 ⲡⲉϥⲟⲩⲱϣⲉ and l. 12 ϣ[ⲁ]ⲣⲉ (8×, each a round dot in the lower bowl, against the undotted ϣ of ϣⲁⲣⲉ, l. 10); every other ϣ undotted and with its tail (lower-zone sheets at 2.2×). ϯ straight in ⲛϯⲟⲩⲣϣⲉ (l. 2) and ⲣⲉϥϯⲥⲃⲱ (l. 5). ⲍ in ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ (ll. 19, 23, 30). Kephalaion 38 (opened 89.18) runs through the whole page; sections open after unmarked blanks with an enlarged Ⲉ or Ⲧ (ll. 2, 22, 23, 27), after "leer" (ll. 9, 18) or in ekthesis (l. 30).
